scenarios.scenarioName: Create a Lead and Convert to Opportunity

acceptanceCriteria.title: Create a New Lead
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C001][AC1] Should create a new Lead successfully

acceptanceCriteria.title: Validate Mandatory Fields During Lead Creation
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C002][AC2] Should validate mandatory fields during Lead creation

acceptanceCriteria.title: Convert Lead to Opportunity
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C003][AC3] Should convert Lead to Opportunity successfully

acceptanceCriteria.title: Verify Opportunity Creation After Lead Conversion
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C004][AC4] Should verify Opportunity creation after Lead conversion

scenarios.scenarioName: Create a Quote with Validation Rules

acceptanceCriteria.title: Create a Quote Successfully
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C005][AC5] Should create a Quote successfully with valid data

acceptanceCriteria.title: Prevent Saving Quote When Discount Exceeds 15% Without Justification
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C006][AC6] Should prevent saving Quote when discount >15% without justification

acceptanceCriteria.title: Allow Saving Quote When Discount Exceeds 15% With Justification
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C007][AC7] Should allow saving Quote when discount >15% with justification

acceptanceCriteria.title: Prevent Saving Quote When Quantity is Zero or Negative
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C008][AC8] Should prevent saving Quote when quantity is zero or negative

acceptanceCriteria.title: Allow Saving Quote with Valid Quantity
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C009][AC9] Should allow saving Quote with valid quantity

scenarios.scenarioName: Create a Quote with Approval Process

acceptanceCriteria.title: Submit Quote for Approval
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C010][AC10] Should submit Quote for approval when discount >20%

acceptanceCriteria.title: Manager Approves Quote
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C011][AC11] Should allow manager to approve Quote

acceptanceCriteria.title: Manager Rejects Quote
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C012][AC12] Should allow manager to reject Quote

acceptanceCriteria.title: Quote Does Not Require Approval for Discounts Up to 20%
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C013][AC13] Should not require approval for discounts ≤20%

scenarios.scenarioName: Create a Quote with Two-Level Approval Process

acceptanceCriteria.title: Submit Quote for First-Level Approval
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C014][AC14] Should submit Quote for first-level approval when discount >50%

acceptanceCriteria.title: First-Level Manager Approves the Quote
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C015][AC15] Should route to Level 2 when Level 1 manager approves

acceptanceCriteria.title: First-Level Manager Rejects the Quote
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C016][AC16] Should route to Level 2 when Level 1 manager rejects

acceptanceCriteria.title: Second-Level Manager Approves the Quote
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C017][AC17] Should finalize approval when Level 2 manager approves

acceptanceCriteria.title: Second-Level Manager Rejects the Quote
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C018][AC18] Should finalize rejection when Level 2 manager rejects

acceptanceCriteria.title: Approval History Tracking
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C019][AC19] Should maintain complete approval history

acceptanceCriteria.title: Quote Does Not Require Two-Level Approval for Discounts of 50% or Less
acceptanceCriteria.testMethod: [C020][AC20] Should not require two-level approval for discounts ≤50%
